user.title: MyIndygo account
user.description: Sign in with the e-mail and password of your MyIndygo app account. This integration is unofficial and not affiliated with Solem.

reauth_confirm.title: [%key:common::config_flow::title::reauth%]
reauth_confirm.description: The MyIndygo cloud rejected the password of {email}. Enter the current password.

error.no_devices: No MyIndygo device was found on this account.

init.title: MyIndygo options
init.description: Keep the polling intervals conservative: the MyIndygo cloud is not designed for frequent polling.

data_description.live_interval: Real-time state of the pool controller, read through the gateway.
data_description.platform_interval: Electrolyser, pH and programs. The electrolyser only reports every 10 to 15 minutes.
data_description.client_id: Leave empty to use the identifier of the MyIndygo app. Only change it if Solem changes the app identifier (format client_id:client_secret).

error.no_devices: No MyIndygo device was found on this account.

start_manual_run.name: Start a forced run
start_manual_run.description: Runs a pool controller output (filtration or auxiliary) for a given time, then returns it to its program. The output must be in mode Auto.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Running time, from 1 minute to 24 hours.

start_boost.name: Start a boost
start_boost.description: Starts a boost of the filtration or treatment output for a given time. The output must be in mode Auto.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Boost time, from 1 minute to 24 hours (seconds are ignored).

pause.name: Pause
pause.description: Pauses a pool controller output, its program included, for a number of days. The output must be in mode Auto.

stop_manual_command.name: Stop the manual command
stop_manual_command.description: Ends the forced run, boost or pause of a pool controller output: it goes back to its program.

filtration_stopped.message: The filtration is stopped: the electrolyser only takes new settings while the filtration runs. Start the filtration first.

filtration_unknown.message: The state of the filtration is unknown (pool controller not reachable): the setting was not sent, since the electrolyser only takes new settings while the filtration runs.

ph_regulation_off.message: The pH setpoint can only be changed while the pH regulation is on.

production_not_percentage.message: The production setpoint can only be changed in the Percentage electrolysis mode.

boost_wintering.message: The electrolyser is wintering: boost is not available.

invalid_setting.message: {value} is not an accepted value for this setting.

no_ipx_output.message: This electrolyser output is unknown to the MyIndygo cloud.

setting_failed.message: The setting could not be sent to the electrolyser: {error}

output_not_auto.message: This output is in mode {mode}: the controller only accepts manual commands on an output in mode Auto. Change its mode in the MyIndygo app first.

boost_not_supported.message: Boost is only available for the filtration and treatment outputs.

not_an_output.message: {entity_id} is not a pool controller output.

no_gateway.message: The gateway relaying this pool controller is unknown.

auth_failed.message: The MyIndygo cloud rejected the credentials. Reauthenticate the integration.

command_failed.message: The command could not be sent to the pool controller: {error}
